title: A-12s at Area 51: row of aircraft on the flight line (p. 298)
description: High-contrast photograph of a line of A-12 aircraft parked diagonally on a concrete apron, with their twin tail fins receding into the distance. The caption reads "A-12s at Area 51." Text below recounts Secretary McNamara's doubts about the need for OXCART given satellite reconnaissance and DCI McCone's argument for overflights of the Soviet Union.
